binding.gesture: {button, select, left {Left} middle {Middle} other {Right}} {kind, select, click {click} other {drag}}
binding.gestureHeld: {mods}+{button, select, left {left} middle {middle} other {right}} {kind, select, click {click} other {drag}}
drag.none: No mouse trigger, the key only
key.announceBack: {label} is back to its default key
key.announceReset: All shortcut keys are back to their defaults
nav.hint: Choose a key, then press the new one. Undo, save, Escape, Tab and ? stay where they are, and Alt is left to the tools. The pattern tool reads the arrow keys itself while it is open, wherever the view steps are.
note.warning: Warning: {problem}, this one is preferred over it
radial.name: Radial menu
radial.taken: {gesture} already does {action, select, orbit {orbit} pan {pan} zoom {zoom} other {something else}} in this preset, so the radial menu is on its key only
setting.presetHint: The left button alone always selects. On Linux the window manager may take Alt+drag to move the window before the app sees it; the middle button presets avoid that.
setting.radialHint: A ring of commands at the cursor, chosen by what you are doing. Hold the trigger, move towards a command and let go, or tap the key and click. Its key is {key} unless you move it below.
